text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown made a stunning debut. The 
Trainer vows to believe in their hard work 
and push forward. Seeing this—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond volunteered to be Satono 
Crown's sub-trainer, wanting to learn 
about training before entering her own 
prime period.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, with new friends joining the fold, 
days of rigorous training began. The next 
goal is the Tokyo Sports Hai Junior 
Stakes.
